recalls.summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Model Y vehicles.  One or both fasteners that secure the left and right second row seat belt retractors may not be properly attached.

Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2018-2020 Model 3 and 2019-2021 Model Y vehicles.  One or both fasteners that secure the front seat shoulder belt to the b-pillar may not be properly attached.

Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2012-2023 Model S, 2016-2024 Model X, 2017-2023 Model 3, 2019-2024 Model Y, and 2024 Cybertruck vehicles.
